# ResetTimer

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzPlus](BlitzPlus) · [System](BlitzPlus-System)

</div>


## Command Syntax

```blitzbasic
ResetTimer timer:Int32
```

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `timer` | Int32 | required | A timer from `CreateTimer`. |

## Description

Sets the tick count of a timer back to 0 and starts counting again from now.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 32, 2
win = CreateWindow("Timer", 20, 20, 240, 100, Desktop(), 3)
tm = CreateTimer(4)
Repeat
	e = WaitEvent()
	If e = $4001 And TimerTicks(tm) >= 8 Then ResetTimer tm
	If e = $4001 Then SetGadgetText win, "Ticks " + TimerTicks(tm)
Until e = $803
```
